name: mplad-insight-monorepo
description: MPLAD Insight — AI-Powered Anomaly & Efficiency Intelligence Platform (SIH 2026 - PS26102)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB,ML" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.dev:ml: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path ml-service/.venv/Scripts/activate.ps1) { . ml-service/.venv/Scripts/activate.ps1; uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir ml-service --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir ml-service --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload }"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=apps/api run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=apps/api run test && npm --workspace=apps/web run test
scripts.test:ml: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path ml-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe) { ml-service/.venv/Scripts/python -m pytest ml-service/tests -o pythonpath=ml-service -v } else { python -m pytest ml-service/tests -o pythonpath=ml-service -v }"

author: Smart India Hackathon 2026 Team
